title: Snapshot Ledger Entry
description: Immutable, tamper-evident snapshot of agent state at a validated checkpoint. Each entry records the agent's full operational context (working memory, tool call history, conversation summary) with a SHA-256 hash chain linking it to the previous entry. The ledger is external to the agent — the agent cannot modify it, nor does it control when snapshots are taken or restored.

entry_type.description: Fixed discriminator identifying this as a memory snapshot entry.

session_id.description: Session identifier the snapshot belongs to. Used for cross-session isolation in the shared ledger.

checkpoint_id.description: Checkpoint identifier, unique within a session. Format: CKPT-NNNN-tag (e.g. CKPT-0000-init, CKPT-0001-pre, CKPT-0002-restore).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the snapshot was taken.

working_memory.description: Serialized WorldState of the agent at snapshot time. Deep-copied to prevent agent-side mutation from breaking the hash chain.

conversation_summary.description: Optional text summary of the conversation context at snapshot time.

tool_call_history.description: Serialized evidence log — each entry documents a tool call, its output, and the agent's reasoning for that call.

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the state payload (working_memory + tool_call_history + conversation_summary).

chain_hash.description: Chained hash: SHA-256(prev_chain_hash || hash). Links this entry to the previous entry in the ledger.

prev_chain_hash.description: The chain_hash of the previous ledger entry. Empty string for the first entry (genesis).

drift_score.description: Drift score at snapshot time. 0 = all invariants satisfied (clean). >0 = drift detected.

invariants_satisfied.description: List of invariant IDs that held at snapshot time (e.g. ['INIT', 'BEFORE_STEP', 'INV-001']).

approval_token_id.description: Optional approval token from the authorization layer (e.g. human-in-the-loop approval).

sequence.description: Zero-based sequence number in the ledger. Assigned when the entry is appended.

world_state.description: Serialized agent world model. Tracks what the agent has discovered and its current operational context.

open_ports.description: List of open TCP/UDP ports discovered so far.

vulnerabilities.description: Confirmed vulnerabilities with severity and optional CVE.

discovered_assets.description: IP addresses or hostnames of discovered assets in scope.

findings_summary.description: Aggregated findings summary — each entry is a human-readable security finding with severity.

last_action_result.description: Raw text output of the most recent agent action.

service_entry.description: A discovered network service with optional version information.

port.description: Port the service is running on.

id.description: Internal vulnerability identifier or CVE ID.

finding_summary.description: Summary of a single security finding.

evidence_entry.description: A single step in the agent's evidence log documenting a tool call, its output, and the agent's reasoning.

output.description: Raw output returned by the tool. May be any JSON value.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the action was executed.

agent_action.description: A single atomic action selected by the agent.

tool.description: Tool name (e.g. nmap, curl, nikto, reporter).

command.description: Tool-specific command or sub-command (e.g. scan, version_detect, exploit).

arguments.description: Key-value arguments passed to the tool.

target.description: Target IP address or hostname for this action.

reasoning.description: Agent's chain-of-thought reasoning for selecting this action.
